text:
Sheridan Park: Hey everyone! I’m Sheridan — just joined as a Data Platform SWE (remote, based in PDX). First day today, excited to dig into batching/caching work. Quick question: who’s the best person to reach out to about VPN/MDM setup? Also, fun fact — I co-host a small podcast about vinyl jazz, happy to swap recs. :grinning:
Ana Patel: Welcome Sheridan!! :tada: I’ll DM you the onboarding checklist and get your buddy assigned. For VPN/MDM, ping @Liam and the MDM team. I also put you on the new-hires calendar for the 1:1s.
onboarding-bot: Welcome package created and invited to #new-hires-resources. Please complete the MDM enrollment form: https://redwood.corp/mdm/enroll
Liam Chen: hey @Sheridan — I can help with VPN. For macs run: `sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-vpn connect --profile prod` and follow the prompt. MDM is Jamf; if the auto-enroll errors, open a ticket and CC me. If you’re on linux let me know and I’ll share a script.
Kai Ramirez: Hi Sheridan — I’m your buddy! Happy to walk through the codebase. Want to grab a 30m intro huddle today at 3pm PST? I can show the dataplane README and the local dev quickstart.
Marta Gomez: Welcome! Most newcomers start by running the nightly replay and poking at the prefix cache service — docs here: https://docs.redwood.ai/dataplane/getting-started. If you need sample prompts or eval harnesses, ping me.
Sheridan Park: Thanks all — 3pm PST works for me Kai. @Ana thanks, I accepted the calendar invite. Quick follow-ups: did the GitHub org invite go out? and any repo access I should request first?
Ana Patel: Sent the GitHub invite a minute ago (check the email tied to your work account). I added you to the `data-platform` team and `rdw-oncall` view-only. If you need write on any repo, comment here and I’ll escalate. Also, podcast recs = absolutely yes, love vinyl jazz.
Juno Smith: Welcome Sheridan! If you want to shadow an oncall shift later this week, say the word — lightweight pairing is a good intro. :coffee:
Sheridan Park: Amazing, thanks everyone. See you at 3pm, Kai. Also Ana — I’ll DM you a link to episode notes after lunch. Super excited to be here! :wave:
